name: When is the best time to start thinking about restoration maintenance after a major repair project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start thinking about restoration maintenance after a major repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to start thinking about restoration maintenance immediately after a major repair project is completed. Establishing a maintenance plan from the outset helps to protect the new work and ensure its longevity. Discussing maintenance options with your contractor before they finish the project can help you understand the recommended care specific to the materials and methods used. Proactive planning helps preserve the quality of the restoration and prevents future issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to plan restoration maintenance is immediately after a major repair project. Discuss options with your contractor to protect new work and ensure its longevity.
